dedupe_keys.name: merit flowtopo a reusable computational foundation for hyperresolution hydrology on the global 90 m drainage network

description: Lulu Jiang and colleagues publish MERIT-FlowTopo, precomputed traversal structures for the global 90 m MERIT Hydro D8 drainage network. Zenodo offers regional GeoTIFF ZIPs with serial visit ranks, conflict-free or as-late-as-possible layer indexes, and subbasin partitions; an extended region supplies alternative structures. A flood-routing or basin simulation can reuse these maps to order upstream computations and partition work without rebuilding topology for every run. The related MERIT-DrainAttr deposit contains computed flow attributes, and a separate MIT code deposit provides algorithms. Coverage is the MERIT Hydro grid, not a higher-resolution local drain map. A limitation is that the underlying flow-direction data must be acquired separately. Zenodo metadata and the public README say CC BY 4.0 for these structures, but the page description also says ODbL 1.0; that rights conflict needs provider clarification. No ZIP was downloaded, and traversal ordering was not recalculated.
